drafts.subject: URGENT: Product Recall Notification - Romaine Lettuce Hearts
drafts.body: This is a recall notification for Romaine lettuce hearts, 3-count bags, packed 12 bags per case. Affected lot codes are L32611443 and L32611452. For all locations (Monterey #201, Watsonville #203, Salinas #204, Seaside #205), immediately PULL and HOLD all affected product. Please hold all product pending confirmation. Our food-safety lead will contact you by phone shortly to confirm next steps.

drafts.subject: URGENT: Product Recall Notification - Romaine Lettuce Hearts
drafts.body: This is a notification regarding a food safety recall. Product: Romaine lettuce hearts, 3-count bags, packed 12 bags per case. Lot Codes: L32611443, L32611452. Action Required: Immediately pull and hold all affected product at locations #310 through #317. Do not distribute or sell. The distributor will confirm next steps by phone shortly.

drafts.subject: URGENT: Product Recall Notification - Romaine Lettuce Hearts
drafts.body: This is a recall notification for Romaine lettuce hearts, 3-count bags, packed 12 bags per case. Affected lot codes are L32611443, PK260827001, and PK260831001. For Corner Basket #12 Oakland, #16 San Leandro, #17 Richmond, and #19 Concord, immediately PULL and HOLD all affected product. For Corner Basket #14 Fremont, HOLD all affected product pending further confirmation. The distributor will confirm specific actions by phone.
